statuses.candidate: Registered with pins, a tier and independence fields; research use only.
statuses.gating: Feeds a verdict that can fail a take or a lane.
statuses.quarantined: A license, terms or provenance problem blocks execution until a maintainer decision.
statuses.retired: Removed from every QC path; only what reads legacy records remains.
statuses.shadow: Runs beside the current judges; its verdicts are uncalibrated and never block.
statuses.warn: Feeds a detector qualified at its warn operating point.

tiers.A: Permissive weights, and training data whose terms allow commercial use, or no learned weights at all.
tiers.B: Permissive weights, but training data includes scraped web audio or corpora whose rights stay with the original owners, with no explicit non-commercial term. Internal, never-shipped evaluation only (decision 2a).
tiers.C: Non-commercial weights, or training data under an explicit non-commercial or research-only term. Never runs in a QC path.
